notes: Photos and videos, rebuilt. Tap any photo, GIF or video to open a full-screen viewer: swipe through all the media in the chat, pinch or double-tap to zoom, pull down to close, and reply, forward, save or jump to the message from there. Videos now have their own player — play, pause, scrub, mute, speed, rotate to landscape — so a video you receive can actually be played (before, the controls in the chat ignored your finger). Video messages show a preview frame and their length, several photos sent together appear as an album, and group info has a new Media page with everything shared, by month. Videos you send are converted to a format every phone and browser can play, and much smaller files: phone-camera HDR clips used to show as a black picture with only sound on some computers. A video that still can't be shown on a device says so plainly, with Play sound only, Save and Open with. Saving now works for videos too, and the chat is told when someone saves a photo or video. View-once photos and videos open in the viewer with a 12-second countdown. Screenshots and screen recording stay blocked in the app, and decrypted copies of media are now cleared from the phone when the app starts and when the Vault locks.
